actors.role: Selects exact recovery Operations and meaning of completion
Owns local business state, result ledger, outbox and explicit continuation
Owns coordination, claims, leases and restart mechanics
Observes separate stores and adjudicates bounded product evidence

product_capability.problem: Process loss can leave business work committed while recovery progress is uncertain.
product_capability.desired_outcome: Resume the same plan with preserved progress and no repeated local business application.

ownership.rule: Only participants changed by one transition join that transaction. Persist intent, exact plan and binding set before dispatch is eligible. No Operation is invoked inside this transaction.

atomic_participants: successful invocation identity and recorded result
ownership.rule: Unique invocation identity plus exact binding/payload digest. Under one write transaction return an existing matching success or apply and record one success atomically. Same identity with different payload/binding rejects. A failed pre-commit call records no applied-success row; durable attempt evidence lives in coordination. No network or external business effects.

success_measures: All 30 bounded scenarios satisfy expected observations in two fresh repetitions
No duplicate local business application for a stable invocation identity
No stale-worker progress commit after takeover
No discarded completed prefix across process restart
